versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the receiving-code-review skill, focused on rigorous and technical handling of code review feedback.
- Introduces a step-by-step response pattern: Read, Understand, Verify, Evaluate, Respond, Implement.
- Explicitly forbids performative agreement and blind implementation; emphasizes technical verification and clarification.
- Provides strategies for handling unclear feedback, prioritizing clarification before any implementation.
- Details differentiated processes for feedback from trusted partners versus external reviewers, including checks for technical soundness and context.
- Includes guidance for handling “professional” features via YAGNI checks, pushback scenarios, implementation order, and appropriate acknowledgment responses.
